correctness.rationale: Writing f=f(root)1+Σ_{v!=root}(f(v)-f(parent v))1_{T_v} identifies edge variation with ℓ1 increment coordinates, hence norm equals largest column V(A1_{T_v}). For t=s_v, g on strict ancestors a is t/s_a; path telescopes 1-t/N while each off-path branch edge contributes t/s_a, giving exact formula. Any nonpath contains degree>=3, producing an ancestor contribution larger than 1/N for a suitable child, whereas paths yield columns ≤1. If S_i denotes sizes along ancestor chain, (b_i-1)<=S_i-S_{i+1}-1 and Σ(S_i-S_{i+1})/S_i<=log(N/t), so norm≤1+N/e. Distributing N−t−sqrt(N) leaves evenly over sqrt(N) ancestor spine vertices ending in t≈N/e subtree yields ≥N/e−O(sqrt N), proving the limit. Independently computed 119 rational direct subtree indicator columns and confirmed formula; read verifier source. No claim of exact finite-N maximum.
residual_risks: Finite checker does not establish an infinite or arbitrary-size theorem
